newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Dallmayr buys Bremen coffee firm Azul.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Dallmayr buys Bremen coffee firm Azul.

text.p: German coffee roaster Alois Dallmayr Kaffee oHG said in a statement it had bought Bremen firm Azul Kaffee GmbH & Co KG, retroactive to July 1, 1997.
Azul, a leading provider of premium coffee products for catering, had sales of 60 million marks in 1996.
Its managing director Helmut Reining said from Bremen he was staying in place after the sale to Dallmayr and would carry on the business as in the past from the Bremen base.
Dallmayr earlier this year said it sold 38,000 tonnes of roasted coffee in 1996 and had a market share of eight percent. Nestle SA Deutschland AG owns 50 percent of Dallmayr.
